values: Observation subclasses per property and feature defined by necessary and sufficient conditions (irrig:Soil30cmDepthMoistureObservation); deductions as caso:Observation subclasses linked to inputs with prov:wasInformedBy; software computing averages typed sosa:Sensor.

The work proposes its own BOP ontology (bop:Executor, bop:Execution, bop:Property, bop:FeatureOfInterest) generalising the SOSA pattern, with bop:hasSimpleResult and property levels, rather than instantiating SOSA.

The ontology invents SOSA names (sosa:Observable, sosa:hasmadeBySensor, sosa:Longitude) and makes Observation a subclass of feature of interest; procedures subclassed into Actuation, Sampling, Publishing, Composing.
Stream services (enrich, aggregation, join) modelled as auxiliary ssn:SensingDevice instances cloned from input sensors; time granularity via ssn:ResponseTime measurement property with a unit.
Observations linked to executed process tasks by a CONSTRUCT rule (meta:observedOn) comparing resultTime with task start and end on the hosting platform.
Quality of Observation attributes (qoo:hasQoO) attached to observation values; virtual sensors described with SSN capabilities.
Sensor subclasses for mobility (hssn:MobileSensor, hssn:StaticSensor) and a coverage area per sensor, tracked over time with past coverage areas and OWL-Time entities.
Actuations with a feature of interest (light, window) and stream rules deriving user events (closeTo, stoppedFrom) from observations.
Social media users treated as social sensors (sosa:Sensor) and tweets annotated with sosa:resultTime and the property they report on.
Observation subclasses per quantity (EnvironmentTemperatureObservation) and a local aal:madeBySensor subproperty used in place of sosa:madeBySensor.
sosa:phenomenonTime used on features of interest to date planting and presence; experimental plots as sosa:Sample; Jena rules derived from properties.

Observation subclasses (HeartObservation, MovementObservation, WalkingFeature) defined by OWL equivalent-class restrictions on observedProperty and feature, so DL reasoning classifies observations; features are abstract individuals (movement, heart) and observations are interpreted through DUL situations.

Neural network models described as S3N procedures with ssn:hasInput/hasOutput and procedure features whose conditions (RAM, Flash) carry schema:value and schema:unitCode with OM units; matching models to devices by system capabilities.
Per-observation quality assessment results (IDQA vocabulary) attached to sosa:Observation as data properties after SHACL validation.
sosa:observes on the sensor used to determine the sensor type; SOSA/IoTStream entities stored in an NGSI-LD broker.
Replaces sosa:actsOnProperty with an own 'actsOn' relation between Actuator and ActuableProperty after its reasoner inferred Actuation and Actuator equivalent.
Machines of a digital twin ontology composed of SOSA sensors, actuators and platforms, with events as machine outputs.
ioe:System subclasses ssn:System; agents' preferences are defined on an ssn:Property measured in a site, with a preferred value.
sosa:Sensor and sosa:Platform used only as prov:Agent of the activity that generated a dataset (DCAT, Data Cube), with no observations.
Observation and sensor output subclasses per quantity (em:PolyphaseVoltageObservation); stream queries construct alert events typed with DUL.

veo:Device is declared a subclass of both sosa:ObservableProperty and sosa:Sampler, and sosa:Sensor is said to represent a feature measured by the network; sosa:Platform specialised as a seismic network.
IoT devices modelled as a subclass of sosa:Platform inside a privacy preference ontology, with no observations.
Each observation identified by a 32-character id; the observation carries value and date as data properties.
Track_Section declared a subclass of ssn:Platform and signalling elements subclasses of ssn:SensingDevice, composed through DUL:hasComponent restrictions in a railway layout ontology.
Names an own class in the sosa namespace (sosa:ObservableVehicleProperty) and own relations observesVehicleProperty; ADAS as ssn:System subclass for forensic investigation.
sosa:hasSimpleResult applied to the result node rather than the observation; Jena rules over observations for fault detection and control, with Brick points.
Sensor results linked to inputs of control logic through SEAS communication connections; checking observations against the measurement range of the sensor model.
Raster analysis outputs turned into per-territory observations, with provenance to the source raster through prov:wasDerivedFrom.
sosa:isHostedBy combined with an own hasComponent hierarchy to trace anomalous data streams back to components and failure modes.
Assets of a production chain described as accomplishing procedures whose results trigger events; no SOSA instance data shown.
Observation IRIs minted from the device metric path plus a timestamp by RML streaming mappings.
Each dataset record (soil sample, image, GPS fix) becomes an observation individual (Soil_ID, Image_ID); taxonomy classes used for animal features.
SOSA classes used only as qb:concept of Data Cube dimensions and measures, combined with SKOS concepts.
Legacy SSN extended with a wearable sensor platform subclass placed on body parts, aligned with BFO and HL7 FHIR.
Observations and sensor descriptions are stored in two graphs of an IoT registry, joined through the identifier of the sensor (legacy SSN).
A bus stop in a route is modelled as a sosa:Sensor, and expected arrival times as observations whose feature of interest is the stop.
Observations are stream events whose materialised inferences are cached by structure; sensors and properties are static background knowledge.
An own class of collections of EV registrations (ev-ont:ElectricVehicleRegistrationCollection) modelled on sosa:ObservationCollection, without SOSA observations.
CSV on the Web metadata maps middleware CSV rows to legacy SSN observations, minting IRIs from sensor and time columns.
Detected bounding boxes linked to tracked objects with sosa:isSampleOf, asserted by soft ASP rules for video stream fusion.
RDF-star detection and tracking triples annotated with sosa:resultTime (frame index) and a score, without sosa:Observation individuals.
Property IRIs invented in the ssn namespace; IFC devices linked to sensors by ssn:observedBy.
Lists ssn:PowerConsumption among SSN core entities, a term that SSN does not define, with legacy ssn:ObservationValue and ssn:SensorOutput.
Maps its SensorObservationValue concept to sosa:SensorOutput, a term SOSA does not define.
Attributes of grid-cell features modelled as observations in an ontology design pattern, with RCC8 spatial relations between features.
sosa:Procedure used for the steps of actuations; locations of physical entities through a geo:Location class that GeoSPARQL does not define.
ssn:hasProperty links objects of video scenes to their characteristics in a causal knowledge graph, outside any sensing context.
Device descriptions as ontology templates whose subsystems (ssn:hasSubSystem) and producible observations are declared by class restrictions.
